ctx.x: -- Vernelly, (unintelligible), and the other singer whose name escapes me at the moment -- it'll come to me. But it was just -- everybody seemed so happy to see you and they asked me to stand up, take a bow, here's Wilbur home. It was a different feeling then. They seemed proud.
